subject: website
name: Orivon Explore
summary: Orivon's directory of Web3 sites, open source, and judged here by its own publisher. It runs only its own files and makes no network request: the directory ships inside the page. Which sites it lists, and at which address, is the publisher's choice, fixed in each build.

operations.name: Browse and filter the directory
operations.note: Runs entirely on this computer. Nothing is sent while you browse.
